svg.title: Inam Ullah Khan — Making health data meaningful.
svg.desc: Research vision connecting retinal vascular morphology and quantitative ocular biomarkers with lipidomics, genomics, microbiome, proteomics, metabolomics, clinical data and wearable signals. The retinal and vessel images are unaltered crops of the author's public RetinalInsight demonstration. Lines indicate integration themes, not established causal effects.

g.text: Connections represent research themes and integration directions.
